assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: empty background plate for an interactive 3D point-cloud viewer, wide landscape 16:9. Primary request: a tasteful pale cool-grey photography studio cyclorama, seamless gently curved floor to backdrop, soft atmospheric falloff, subtle matte texture, refined and quiet. Absolutely empty: no aircraft, no product, no model, no people, no props, no text, no logo, no watermark, no graphic frame. The central 70 percent must be clean low-detail negative space for a separately rendered white aircraft or object. Medium silver-grey tonal values around the center so a white model will remain legible. Broad diffuse studio illumination, no bright hotspot, no object-shaped shadow. Camera straight ahead, very gentle floor transition confined to bottom quarter. Produce the background only, edge to edge, photorealistic.
assets.postprocessing: JPEG format conversion at quality 88; no content edits
